name: Sentinel Web3 Risk Scanner
tagline: Real-Time Web3 Security Diagnostic & Pre-Execution Threat Scanner for Anna AI OS
description:
Sentinel Web3 Risk Scanner provides institutional-grade transaction simulation, calldata inspection, and revert diagnostics directly into the Anna AI OS desktop and chat agent.

### Core Security Features
- **Pre-Execution Calldata Threat Analysis:** Inspect raw EVM transaction payloads before signing to identify unlimited token approvals (type(uint256).max), unverified function selectors, and suspicious recipient routing.
- **Token Safety & Honeypot Audit:** Analyze ERC-20 smart contracts for honeypot transfer restrictions, excessive transfer taxes, mint privileges, and proxy vulnerabilities on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, and Arbitrum.
- **EVM Revert & Panic Diagnostics:** Decode raw revert bytes and Solidity panic codes (such as Panic(0x11) arithmetic overflow or custom DEX slippage errors) into clear root cause explanations and actionable remediation steps.
- **Security Telemetry Daemon:** Track gas protected, threats intercepted, and active network health monitors in real-time.

### Host & Chat Agent Integration
Invoke security checks naturally during wallet operations in Anna Chat or inspect contracts using the dedicated glassmorphic desktop interface.
